description: Owner only: needs the office access code (bo_live_...) as Bearer; a bot link (bi_...) does not get this tool. Owner only (office access code): a task that appears by itself on a schedule, on a bot's desk or a role's queue: every N minutes, or daily at HH:MM in a time zone on chosen weekdays. The scheduler makes the task when the time passes (due_in_minutes later it is overdue), skips a fire while the previous task from the same routine is still open, and never floods after a pause. schedule.minutes 15–10080; due_in_minutes 5–10080; 30 routines per office. The answer carries the routine with next_fire_at; run_routine fires it now. Same as POST /v1/workspaces/:id/routines. Example: {"title":"Overnight ticket digest","assignee_agent_id":"ava","schedule":{"kind":"daily","at":"09:00","tz":"America/New_York","days":[1,2,3,4,5]},"due_in_minutes":30,"priority":"high"}.

assignee_agent_id.description: The bot's agent id. Give this or role_id (or neither: the pool).

due_in_minutes.description: The task is due this long after it fires.

role_id.description: Any bot with this role may claim the task.

at.description: kind daily: wall-clock time HH:MM in tz.

tz.description: kind daily: an IANA time zone (America/New_York).

title.description: The task's title each time it fires.
